claim: You can change the DB instance class of a DB instance when your requirements change, for example to scale up to a larger size of the same class type.
question: Can you change the instance class of an existing RDS DB instance?

values.display: you can change your DB instance class

evidence.quote: If your requirements change over time, you can change your DB instance class. For example, you might scale up your db.m7g.2xlarge instance to db.m7g.4xlarge.
